verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud marketplace, not an agent or assistant. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can consume their tools is an MCP-client role that does not fit this kind of product. The evidence shows only the reverse direction: an agent skill that lets external AI coding assistants drive Vast.ai. Nothing shows Vast.ai itself acting as an MCP client, so the axis stays inapplicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
